newsitem.title: USA: FedEx to offer earlier delivery to Europe.
newsitem.headline: FedEx to offer earlier delivery to Europe.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said Thursday it will cut worldwide transit time to Europe by offering an earlier morning delivery service beginning November 1.

The company will offer International Priority morning delivery by 1030 local from Latin America to more than a dozen major commercial centers in Europe. Federal Express currently serves those commercial centers by noon for morning delivery.

"Because speed to market is increasingly important in a global economy, this is the latest in a long line of FedEx innovations that respond to the need for faster transit times for our customers around the world," Joseph McCarty, senior vice president, FedEx Latin America and the Caribbean, said in a statement.

The cities covered by the new delivery service will include Amsterdam, Antwerp, Basel, Brussels, Cologne, Dusseldorf, Eindhoven, Frankfurt, Geneva, Hamburg, London, Milan, Munich, Stuttgart, and Zurich.
